svg.title: Virgil architecture: detailed implementation and connection map
svg.desc: A detailed map of Virgil's learner inputs, Chrome extension and hosted page, Firebase identity chain, Cloud Run service, Firestore state, Cloud Run Job, eleven-stage Google ADK workflow, Gemini API, explicit local Gemma connector, Google Drive and Notebook route, WebMCP tools, browser handoffs, operations and security boundaries. Arrows distinguish production, learner-chosen, returning evidence and paused optional connections.
svg.text: How Virgil connects learning surfaces, agents and Google Cloud
All Things Agentic submission build · solid = production · dashed = learner-chosen · orange = evidence returning · dotted = paused optional
learner records answer · correction · grade · external outcome
side panel · Quick take · Learn · Check
same authenticated API as the full page
guide view · study state · intake draft
bounded page tools · same session · no model call
to Virgil; no inbound laptop port
Qwen deep text + vision · explicit learner route
public browser gate; data routes gated
pins · courses · board · sessions · plan · insights
spend guard · schema validation · model receipts · no silent fallback
boards · pins · topics · evidence · signals · comfort
external handoffs · outcomes · Notebook file IDs
Job leases · receipts · checkpoints · local mailbox
ONE STATE, NOT A BROWSER SHADOW DATABASE
extension + page + Job open only the verified learner board
deny-all client rules · server/Admin SDK only
bounded writes · concurrency cap · delete protection
direct request completes before service replies
process / process-if-due · per-run nonce · retry-safe lease
same Firestore board · same model spec · same release tag
writes running / finished receipt · survives closed browser
11 ordered, restartable stages · real BaseAgent children
15 named roles; Intake Planner serves both paths
Forager re-fetches sources; Prospector proposes gaps
safe links · source provenance · outside text stays untrusted
checkpoint each stage · bounded failure class
a failed verifier withholds; it never silently patches
Gemini 3.7 Flash · supported, not the deployed default
exact model ID + token counts · schemas · refusal handling
Gemini key ladder · managed Drive refresh grant
runtime: datastore + secret mounts + Job execute only
no project-wide secret role · no unused Vertex role
file IDs in Firestore; refresh grant stays in Secret Manager
Virgil: learn now · on the board · archive
fixed files rewritten in place; learner adds them once
no model call in document projection
Notebook reads Virgil’s three Drive sources
one-way export · Virgil never reads Notebook answers back
learner-chosen browser handoff with prepared context
Virgil records what left; never silently sends it
safe fetch in · manual outcome / backup / restore / delete controls
Firebase subject · membership · deny-all client rules
free→managed only on 429/503 · budget checked first
immutable service + Job images · same release identity
optional recovery floor; not primary dispatch
health · auth 401 · tenant isolation · Job receipt
Server-only Firestore · explicit model routes · one-way Notebook export
